reports.title: AMETEK Announces Record Third Quarter 2026 Results and Raises Full Year Guidance

lines: Adjusted earnings per diluted share are now expected to be in the range of $8.53 to $8.57, up approximately 15% from our full year 2025 results.

This is an increase from our prior guidance range of $8.20 to $8.30 per diluted share reflecting our excellent third quarter results and outlook for the fourth quarter, as well as the expected contribution from the acquisition of Indicor Instrumentation,” he added.
“For the fourth quarter of 2026, overall sales are expected to be up in the low 20% range versus the fourth quarter of 2025.
Adjusted earnings in the quarter are expected to be in the range of $2.26 to $2.30 per share, up 12% to 14% compared to the fourth quarter of 2025,” concluded Mr.
